Alaska’s Coastline is Longer Than All the Other 49 States Combined
items.summary: Alaska is a land of geographic extremes. It contains the nation’s highest mountain, more lakes than any other state, and more than 100,000 glaciers and ice fields.

items.title: NVIDIA Harnesses Vera CPU to Speed Up Design of Next-Generation CPUs and GPUs
items.summary: The complexity of modern chip design continues to grow as engineering teams work to develop increasingly sophisticated CPUs, GPUs and AI systems.

items.title: Google signs EU AI Act Code of Practice on AI-generated content transparency
items.summary: Google has announced that it is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content to support responsible AI use and transparency around AI-generated content in Europe.

items.title: BSI sets AI quality standard for EU high-risk systems
items.summary: BSI has published a standard for quality management systems under the EU AI Act, aimed at organisations placing high-risk AI systems on the EU market.

items.title: Google signs EU AI Act transparency code, backs AI content labelling while warning against regulatory complexity
items.summary: Google has signed the European Union's AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content, reaffirming its commitment to responsible AI deployment while raising concerns that overly complex regulatory requirements could hinder innovation and create confusion for users.
